## 1.1.0 - sharper odds + minimap tracking

Odds calibration (opt-in): RUN can now check its own predictions against reality.
On first login it asks once - if you say yes, RUN records, on your machine, how
its predicted odds lined up with how fights actually went (the creature, your
level, the odds, and win or lose - no names, no positions). It stays on your
device unless you choose to build a /ra share link yourself. Over time this
sharpens the odds for everyone. Decline and nothing is recorded - and you can
change your mind anytime in the options.

Minimap dot now tracks the rare: the tier-coloured dot follows the rare's real
position on your minimap (via its vignette) instead of sitting at your own
location, and it no longer re-pings - it marks a sighting once and the subtle dot
trails the rare as it moves. The dot is independent of the banner, so you can keep
a sighting low-key.

Works on WoW: Forever (1.60.x) and Classic Era (1.15.x). Display-and-advice only,
official APIs only, never networks - you auto-update through your addon manager.
